description: Localization script for Russian language for a calendar library, defining date formats, month and weekday names, relative time strings, and calendar display texts.

methods.name: n
methods.description: Function to select correct Russian declension for time units based on number.

methods.name: a
methods.description: Function to generate relative time strings with correct declension.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Function to get the correct month name in nominative or accusative case.

methods.name: r
methods.description: Function to get the abbreviated month name in nominative or accusative case.

methods.name: s
methods.description: Function to get the weekday name in nominative or accusative case.
